notes.title: v1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
[p]Dear players, hello!

We're incredibly grateful for your continued support and valuable feedback. We've diligently gathered your recent suggestions and implemented a host of optimizations and fixes in this update to enhance your overall game experience. Here's a breakdown of what's new:

[/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p] Added “Auto Sell Upgrade” in the shop: shortens the interval for auto-selling items[/p][/*][*][p] Added “Auto Purchase” in the shop: automatically buys refreshed items[/p][/*][*][p] Added option “Apply to Select All Button” in auto-sell settings
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p] Increased speed when long-pressing bait[/p][/*][*][p] Optimized the sorting of aquarium decorations[/p][/*][*][p] Optimized the clickable area for locked items in the fish basket interface[/p][/*][*][p] Fish basket now remembers the last sorting selection for the current game
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed issue where upgrade icons still appeared after reaching max level[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where fish acquisition prompts sometimes repeated[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed rare cases of missing affinity gifts[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed minor text errors
[/p][/*][/list][p]Your continued suggestions and feedback are always welcome! Feel free to join our community to share your thoughts and discuss the game. We're committed to continuously refining and enhancing [i]Fischer's Fishing Journey[/i] to make it the best experience possible. Meanwhile, we're also diligently working on exciting new content, including brand new scenes, more diverse fish, new NPCs, and much more! If you have any creative ideas, we'd love for you to share and discuss them with us![/p]

notes.title: My favorite new desktop buddy on Steam is a cat that goes fishing
notes.content: Cats like fish, which is a stereotypical gag kind of thing but also true because I imagine most carnivores like fish. Anyway, what if a cat was named Fischer and it liked to go fishing and that was it, that was the whole thing? If you like that as much as I do then probably you will also like the idea of Fischer's Fishing Journey,.. Read more.

notes.title: 🎣Sneak Peek at Upcoming Content | More Scenes, Fish, and a Mysterious Surprise!
notes.content:
Dear Anglers,

Thank you for your continued love and support for Fischer's Fishing Journey! It's your companionship that makes the cat's fishing journey so warm and special. We're currently preparing a whole new batch of content and we can't wait to share what's coming—let's take a look!

[h3]🌅 New Scenes[/h3]

We're designing more scenes and fishing spots that will take you to some truly unexpected places

[h3]🐟 More Types of Catches[/h3]

The variety of what you can reel in is getting an upgrade—and it might not just be fish!

[h3]🐾 NPCs with Stories[/h3]

New NPCs are on their way, and they'll bring their own unique stories to share with you!

[h3]🎮 A Mysterious Collaboration[/h3]

A surprise cross-dimensional interaction is coming soon! Who would you love to see appear in Fischer's world?

[h3]🏠 More Decorations [/h3]

To help you build your very own unique little fishing haven.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363270/_/

Want to be the first to get the latest news? Join our community to meet more fellow anglers and share fishing tips and fun together

notes.title: v1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a feature in the settings to switch displays in fullscreen and wallpaper modes.
[*] Added master volume control and a background auto-mute option in the settings (due to implementation limitations, background auto-mute is currently unavailable in wallpaper mode).
[*] Fixed an issue where the wallpaper mode window position was abnormal on multi-monitor setups.
[*] Optimized fullscreen and wallpaper mode compatibility for various screen aspect ratios.
[*] Added position limits for windows so they will no longer appear outside the visible screen area after restarting the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where switching to desktop pet mode would cause the UI to gradually shift.
[*] Fixed an issue where mini-games sometimes failed to refresh.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck on the start screen in rare cases
[*] Fixed display anomalies in windowed mode on dual-monitor setups
[*] Fixed an issue where cats would stop fishing in certain special cases
[*] Fixed the shop not upgrading when region completion was exactly 25%
[*] Fixed an issue where auto-sell would sell locked fish
[*] Fixed the remaining time not showing after switching maps while in accelerated state
[*] Fixed abnormal refresh issues in mini-games in some cases
[*] Fixed layer errors in the Glimmer Well
[*] Optimized some description texts
[*] Settings files are now saved locally and no longer uploaded to the cloud to avoid some display issues (this change will reset settings in the game menu and require reconfiguration)
[/list]
